audit.whatIsWrong: Two rows contradict their own explanations. win[2] gives Level 3 to Riven while whys[2] says 'your Q re-cast true damage plus W max-HP slash out-trade her Q-poke', spikes[1] calls 3-5 your window and mid opens 'this is your lane'. win[5] gives First item to Riven while whys[5] says 'your first-item spike keeps the duel and R picks her in skirmishes'.
audit.why: 52.97% over 489 games is a favoured lane and the prose consistently describes Camille taking over from level 3, so the two rows look like the error. I could not propose the flip: 'Riven' is 5 characters and 'Camille' is 7, outside the applier's +/-10% band for win[]/side fields.
audit.corrected: Left the rows and the whys untouched and raised it in questionsForUser rather than invent a shift.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Punish the long Q and E cooldowns' and 'bait her E shield-dash, then commit' are the plan, and no Riven cooldown is given anywhere. Blade of the Exile is never mentioned at all, so her real level-6 and level-11 spikes are missing from a matchup that lists spikes.
audit.why: Broken Wings is a flat 13s for the whole three-cast chain, Ki Burst 11/10/9/8/7s, Valor 10/9/8/7/6s, Blade of the Exile 120/90/60s. The flat 13s on Broken Wings is the punish window, and it never shortens with ranks - which is exactly why the plan keeps working.
audit.corrected: mid, whys[3], early and wants.you[0] now carry Broken Wings' flat 13s and Valor's 10s, and late names Blade of the Exile.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (1) 'Her shield-empowered burst' appears three times, as if the shield is what makes her damage lethal. Valor's shield blocks damage; the thing that amplifies her burst is Blade of the Exile, which grants attack damage and RANGE and adds a ranged Wind Slash - and it appears nowhere in the matchup. (2) 'Q3 knockup' in three places: Riot's text for Broken Wings says the third hit KNOCKS BACK nearby enemies. A knock-back pushes you out of your own melee range, which is a different problem from being launched in place. Riven's passive is also absent - Runic Blade charges off her abilities and is spent by her autos, which is why her damage comes in weaves rather than in the spells themselves.
audit.why: Riot, Broken Wings: 'Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.' Valor: 'Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.' Blade of the Exile: 'Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.' Runic Blade: 'Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.'
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text, early, whys[0] and wants.foe[0] use knock-back and name Runic Blade weaving; late replaces the 'shield-empowered burst' with Blade of the Exile's AD, range and Wind Slash.

edits.before: Riven's spike is a fast Q1-Q2 into Q3 knockup plus W stun — once those are leveled, eating the chain in melee chains you long enough for her shield-empowered burst to kill.
edits.after: Riven's spike is a fast Q1-Q2 into the Q3 knock-back plus Ki Burst stun — once those are leveled, eating the chain in melee holds you long enough for her Runic Blade auto-weave to kill you.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 Riven's Q dashes and W stun come online while you have one ability — don't melee her into a knockup stun.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 her Broken Wings and Ki Burst come online while you have one ability — don't melee into the knock-back and stun.

edits.before: Chain Q1-Q2 into the Q3 knockup, then W-stun you inside her shield-empowered burst before your re-cast lands
edits.after: Chain Q1-Q2 into the Q3 knock-back, then Ki Burst you and cash the Runic Blade charges before your re-cast lands

edits.before: Bait her E shield-dash and W stun, then E-in, W-pull, and land the Q re-cast sweetspot while her dashes are down
edits.after: Bait Valor's shield-dash (10s) and Ki Burst, then E-in, W-pull and land the Q re-cast sweetspot while her dashes are down

edits.before: You out-trade her on her long Q and E cooldowns — bait her E shield-dash and W stun, then commit your combo.
edits.after: You out-trade her while Broken Wings sits on its flat 13s — bait Valor and Ki Burst first, then commit your combo.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is Riven's: she has fast Q dashes and her W stun coming online while you only have one ability, so don't sit in melee and eat a Q3 knockup into W stun and her shield-empowered burst. The lane flips once you have a second point — E-Q in, land the second Q re-cast for the true-damage hit, then back off before her dashes reset. Don't waste your E-hookshot while her E shield is up or while she can sidestep it; bait the dash out, then commit.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is Riven's: she has fast Broken Wings dashes and Ki Burst coming online while you only have one ability, so don't sit in melee and eat a Q3 knock-back into the stun and a Runic Blade auto-weave. The lane flips once you have a second point — E-Q in, land the second Q re-cast for the true-damage hit, then back off before her dashes reset. Don't spend your Hookshot while Valor (10s) is up; bait the dash out, then commit.

edits.before: This is your lane. Your Q re-cast true damage and W's outer-edge max-HP slash out-trade her Q-poke, and W heals you off her every time you connect, so you reset toward full while she burns flask. Dodge her Q3 knockup and her W stun, then punish the long Q and E cooldowns. At 6, R traps her in the arena — she can't Q-dash through the wall or E out — so isolate her, W-pull, and Q-sweetspot her down before she can combo back.
edits.after: This is your lane. Your Q re-cast true damage and W's outer-edge max-HP slash out-trade her poke, and W heals you off her every time you connect, so you reset toward full while she burns flask. Dodge the Q3 knock-back and Ki Burst, then punish the flat 13s on Broken Wings and the 10s on Valor. At 6, R traps her in the arena — no Broken Wings dash through the wall, no Valor out — so isolate her, W-pull, and Q-sweetspot her down.

edits.before: You keep the duel through your first item — your Q cooldown and W sustain win the straight 1v1, and R still isolates her in skirmishes. The danger is a fed Riven at 2+ items: her shield-empowered combo burst and mobility let her sidestep your E-hookshot and delete you before W's heal matters. Close the lane early, snowball your tempo into picks with R, and end before her item spikes outpace your damage.
edits.after: You keep the duel through your first item — your Q cooldown and W sustain win the straight 1v1, and R still isolates her in skirmishes. The danger is a fed Riven at 2+ items: Blade of the Exile hands her attack damage, extra RANGE and a Wind Slash she can throw from outside your reach, and her dashes sidestep your Hookshot. Close the lane early, snowball your tempo into picks with R, and end before her item spikes outpace your damage.

edits.before: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Riven's Ki Burst is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. Camille is favoured here.
edits.after: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash knock-up and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Riven's Ki Burst is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. Camille is favoured here.

edits.before: Good trade: Lead with the W outer edge as Riven steps to last-hit, weave the empowered Q2 true damage, then peel out on your bonus move speed before the fight goes long. Great trade: Riven uses or whiffs Ki Burst (Stun): instantly E off a wall for the stun and attack-speed surge, Q-recast for the true-damage second hit, W to heal, and R to isolate him if he tries to run. Bad trade: Burning Hookshot (E) aggressively, missing the stun, and getting stuck in a drawn-out melee grind while your E and shield are down. That is how Camille loses a winning lane.

notes: Blade of the Exile is not mentioned once in this matchup, in either layer - her ult, her level-6 and level-11 spikes, and the source of the extra range that lets a fed Riven hit you from outside your own reach. The page instead credits her burst to a 'shield-empowered' combo three times, which puts the amplification on Valor, an ability that only blocks damage. Also corrected: 'Q3 knockup' in three places - Riot's text says the third Broken Wings hit knocks BACK, which shoves you out of your own melee range rather than holding you in it.
